A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
MPNSTs do not arise from vestibular schwannomata in unirradiated patients with NF2.
MPNST are a feature of neurofibromatose type 2 (in the unirradiation patient) and not a feature of neurofibrmatose type 1 (in the un irradiation patient).
MPNST are not a feature of neurofibromatose type 2 (unirradiated patients).
The main takeaway from our work is that
the literature on the association of MPNST in NF2 needs to be reviewed critically and the data reanalyzed.
NF2 patients should be reassured that the risk of developing MPNST in the vestibular schwannomanoma is very small.
the incidence of MPNST in NF2 is likely to be very low, and the majority of MPNST in patients with NF2 are radiation-induced.
